metadata.name: Pushbutton Alarm Reset
metadata.description: Tactile button with pulldown resistor for disabling the alarm

wires.description: Wire from power rail to button leg0 at 3E. Provides 3.3V when button pressed.
Wire from Pico GPIO16 to junction at 4B. Reads button state (HIGH when pressed, LOW when not).
Wire from ground rail to pulldown resistor at 9A. Keeps GPIO LOW when button not pressed.
